prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Platinum (Pt) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a fully lined crochet two-piece — a short-sleeved crochet crop top and a matching mini skirt — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a plain polished platinum ring held up to the light, untarnished low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: paused mid-walk, weight on the front foot.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — platinum: a dense, cool white metal that never changes — it does not rust, tarnish or dissolve in almost any acid; once tossed aside by Spanish gold-washers as worthless 'little silver', it became rarer and costlier than gold; for 130 years a small cylinder of platinum and iridium sealed under three nested glass bell jars was the kilogram itself, the measure of the world; a catalyst that makes hydrogen burst into flame and other substances transform at its touch while it stays untouched; aloof, exacting and incorruptible — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
